description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of License issued to Commercial Leasing and Finance PLC
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the cancellation of a finance business license for Commercial Leasing & Finance PLC due to its amalgamation with LOLC Finance PLC under the Finance Business Act. This falls under business and commercial matters, specifically the regulation of financial institutions, making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6). The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories like Land, Legal, Elections, Public Service, or Judicial matters.
